system.description:
As an action spend three Stamina and gaze upon a creature visible to you within twenty yards and make a Samurai ability roll against a pure Will roll. On a win, characters of equal Arcane Might to you are Frightened. Should you score a critical win characters of equal Arcane Might at Terrified. Characters of greater Arcane Might count their level of success as one greater, only becoming Frightened should you score a critical win. Characters of lesser Arcane Might who you win this test against are either Terrified or rendered completely unable to move. In all cases this effect lasts for a minute, or till you are no longer in their presence. Creatures that have successfully resisted this ability are immune to it until their next rest.

At Arcane Might IV or greater you may use this ability on ten targets at once and creatures without an Arcane Might or a Will score of four or higher automatically fail their save. At Arcane Might VI you may use it on up to a hundred targets at once.
system.requirement: Requires the Blessing of a Yokai of Arcane Might III or greater
